findings.note: The Registry document retained as step 5's snapshot is not bound to the Registry independently rediscovered and read by validate-capability-registry and generate-registry-digest --whole. The implementation report explicitly confirms that neither dependency receives the located Registry path. Different discovery results can therefore validate/hash different bytes from those used for capability evaluation, violating REQ-001's single fixed Registry snapshot and context_binding.registry_digest provenance contract.

An affected component absent from the Context Projection is silently evaluated using an empty properties object via projection_components.get(component_id, {}). This converts an inconsistent dependency result into ordinary DSL WARN/false behavior instead of treating the dependency output as malformed and failing closed, so the Resolver may emit the wrong diagnostic and conceal a broken affected-component-to-Context binding.
